description: SDG 11.5.3 Damage to Critical Infrastructure and Number of Disruptions to Basic Services Attributed to Disasters is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. SDG 11.5.3: (a) damage to critical infrastructure and (b) number of disruptions to basic services attributed to disasters, Qatar, 2016-2021. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are infrastructure, disasters. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-08-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency shelter and critical facility planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
